head-and-face.title: Tèt, Je, Zòrèy, Nen, Bouch
head-and-face.bodyMarkdown:
Start with these body-part words:

- **Tèt** — Head
- **Je** — Eye
- **Zòrèy** — Ear
- **Nen** — Nose
- **Bouch** — Mouth

Learn each Kreyòl word with its English meaning.

upper-body.title: Kou, zepòl, Lestomak, Bra, Men
upper-body.bodyMarkdown:
Add these body-part words:

- **Kou** — Neck
- **zepòl** — Shoulder
- **Lestomak** — Chest
- **Bra** — Arm
- **Men** — Hand

In this course, learn **Lestomak** as **Chest**.

abdomen-and-foot.title: vant and Pye
abdomen-and-foot.bodyMarkdown:
Finish with these two body-part words:

- **vant** — Abdomen
- **Pye** — Foot

Together with the earlier cards, these complete the 12 body-part words in this lesson.
